learning_outcomes.text: Learning the definition and classification of chemical process units.
Ability to select appropriate process equipment and materials.
Ability to design mass transfer, processing, and storage equipment.
Ability to design heat and mass transfer equipment.
Ability to communicate in written and oral form.

syllabus_topics: General Definition and Classification of Chemical Process Units
Design of Material Handling Equipment: Basic Concepts of Fluid Transport
Piping in Fluid Transport Processes; Pumping of Fluids
Compression and Expansion of Fluids; Agitation and Mixing of Fluids
Storage of Fluids; Transport and Processing of Solids

Design of Heat Transfer Equipment: Basic Design Method and Theory; Selection of Heat Exchanger Type; Design of Shell and Tube Heat Exchangers; Tube Side Heat Transfer Coefficient and Pressure Drop; Shell Side Heat Transfer Coefficient and Pressure Drop
Design of Separation Equipment: Selection of Separation Processes; Continuous Distillation; Design Methods for Binary Systems; Multi-component Distillation
Introduction to Crystallization; Design of Crystallization Units
bibliography: Peters, M.S., Timmerhaus, K.D., Plant Design and Economics for Chemical Engineers, 5th Ed., McGraw-Hill, Inc., Singapour, 2003.
Towler, G., Sinnott, R.K., Chemical Engineering Design Practice and Economics of Plant and Process Design, 2nd Ed., Elsevier Butterworth-Heinemann, 2013.
Geankoplis, C.J., Hersel, A.A., Lepek, D.H., Transport Processes and Separation Process Principles, 5th Ed., Pearson Education,Inc., 2018.
Couper, J.R., Penney, W. R., Fair. J.R., Walas, S.M., Chemical Process Equipment, Elsevier Inc., 2005.
